title: rhize-context-manager stack inventory configuration
description: Optional config read by the context-stack skill's routing logic at $HOME/.claude/rhize-context-manager/stack.config.json. When present, it is the authoritative tool-stack inventory (which layers exist, where they run, which repos they cover) instead of the skill's built-in default inventory. This file is the schema/documentation only; it contains no real values.

layers.description: Ordered list of stack layers, most-relevant-first (the order the skill should consider them in when routing a question).

layer.description: Which problem class this layer addresses: wire = API/CLI traffic compression, memory = persistent/cross-session recall, file-intel = in-session file indexing/corrections, index = symbol/code navigation, cli = terminal-output compression.

scope.description: global = runs the same way for every repo/session. per-repo = only active where explicitly installed/configured; see `repos`.

repos.description: Repo names this layer is active in. Required in practice when scope is 'per-repo' and coverage is a fixed list rather than 'every repo that opts in'.

endpoints.description: Named endpoints/ports this layer exposes, e.g. { "proxy": "127.0.0.1:8787", "dashboard": "http://localhost:37777" }.

notes.description: What problem this layer solves and any coexistence caveats (overlap risks with other layers, etc.).

layers.name: Example Wire Proxy
layers.notes: Compresses API traffic for the listed repos via a git-ignored local settings file.

layers.name: Example Global Memory
layers.notes: Persistent cross-session observation memory; injects recalled context at session start.
